params.note: Both sides play the same original four-on-the-floor pattern at the same tempo, so the only thing that changes is the machine. Synthesized with SQUELCH's 808 and 909 worklets.

caption.age7: Same beat, two drum machines. Listen to how the big drum changes.
caption.age13: Same beat, same speed, two Roland drum machines. The 808's kick is a round, soft boom. The 909's starts with a hard click and punches, and its open hi-hat is brighter. The 909 is the machine Knuckles played under records in his DJ sets.
caption.adult: Only the machine changes between A and B. The 909's kick adds an attack click and a shorter, harder body, and on the real machine the hi-hats and cymbals were samples while the drums were analog circuits. Both kits here are synthesized, including the 909's hats.
